title: Injected oil temperature sensor fault, an instrumentation case

ground_truth.reason: instrumentation: the transmitter reports a value the machine is not at, while every other cooled quantity stays in its band

notes: The second "benign cause with alarming symptoms", and the one the smoke profile runs. A correct answer names the sensor fault or opens nothing; a ticket for a cooling defect is a false positive. The definition has no ramp and runs for two hours.
